text: tcr intercepts chatgpt.com from now on: codex started with `tcr run --codex` is pooled; a codex that reaches this proxy some other way needs CODEX_CA_CERTIFICATE set to tcr's CA, or chatgpt.com in NO_PROXY to stay on its own login

reason: the ChatGPT login that came back is carol@example.com, not the one 'erin@example.com/codex' holds. Sign out of chatgpt.com in the browser first, or use a private window, then retry `tcr login --codex --account erin@example.com/codex`. Nothing was written.
